metadata.description: Instagram reel deep-dive content analysis — scrape, rank, and build an interactive HTML report with a 0-100 Reel Health Score.

plugins.name: instagram-deepdive
plugins.description: Turn an Instagram URL into an interactive zine-style deep-dive: storyboard, cut/pacing, 3s hook breakdown, emotion-flow chart, why-it-went-viral metrics, benchmarking patterns, and a 0-100 Reel Health Score with Quick Wins. Requires the Apify MCP (+credits), Node.js, and ffmpeg.
